scope: Read-only independent review of pure mounting assessment, ATFNODE review/check integration and source boundaries. No live AutoCAD and no engineering approval of an assembly.

findings.evidence: Strict existing catalogue/source validator plus same-selection SHA comparison precede report creation; null and foreign selection/source exercised by independent real C# probe.

Local clearance/scheme insertion remains independent. All seven dependency states and mounting status are unconfirmed; automatic selection is always false, including 124 varied valid catalogue combinations.

Public result properties have no public setters, all outward collections reject mutation, caller edits do not change existing report. Profile b/c use R/InvariantCulture text; double.Epsilon and 1e-29 do not become new plane numeric refusals.

Command adds assessment only after original owner/body/units and source freshness checks; stale, COPY, altered body, changed units and cancellation produce no mounting report. Existing saved snapshot and DWG dump unchanged.
Actual CAD adapters with doubles remain 62 GetObject and 47 own primitive visits per check; one project plus one zone read; 10000 unrelated objects add no ModelSpace enumeration.
No geometry/store/renderer/schema changes. Old pure node gate1270 passes including exact numeric/digest fixtures. Assessment leaves old result serialization and digest unchanged.

Reviewed precise named missing datums/overlap/holes/fit chain against source-review locators. No L(KR2)+L(UK) envelope, +4 fit tolerance, min30 transfer, profile section approval, or fixed/sliding/continuity inference introduced.

Form preserves CRLF, read-only vertical scroll and current CanInsert; input/back invalidation clears hidden old report. Native UI assertions cover full current report, source locators, dedicated small-window mounting scroll and large-font tail. Probe compiles locally but actual Windows screenshots still require inspection after CI.
